selection.name: Bitcoin and world history: 150 dates
selection.method: Curated historical events and market or network turning points, with one latest-day comparison. Selection is editorial, not an objective ranking; dates cannot establish causation.

added.label: Fed expands quantitative easing
added.context: The Federal Reserve expands asset purchases and announces purchases of longer-term Treasury securities.

added.label: Iran presidential election
added.context: Iran holds its disputed presidential election; large protests follow.

added.label: US Flash Crash
added.context: US markets experience the Flash Crash.

added.label: Tunisian uprising begins
added.context: Protests beginning in Tunisia become a starting point of the Arab Spring.

added.label: Tohoku earthquake and Fukushima
added.context: An earthquake and tsunami strike Japan, triggering the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident.

added.label: US credit rating downgrade
added.context: Standard & Poor’s lowers the United States’ long-term sovereign rating from AAA to AA+.

added.label: Gold's 2011 record
added.context: Gold reaches its 2011 London PM fixing record during the sovereign-debt crisis.

added.label: Draghi: whatever it takes
added.context: ECB President Mario Draghi pledges to do what is necessary within the bank’s mandate to preserve the euro.

added.label: Obama reelected
added.context: US presidential election day. Barack Obama wins reelection; vote counting extends beyond this UTC snapshot.

added.label: Cyprus bank bailout agreement
added.context: The Eurogroup announces an agreement concerning Cyprus’s bank restructuring and bailout.

added.label: Snowden surveillance disclosures
added.context: NSA surveillance disclosures bring digital privacy into worldwide debate.

added.label: Russia annexes Crimea
added.context: Russia announces the annexation of Crimea, which is internationally contested.

added.label: First US Marshals Bitcoin auction
added.context: The US Marshals Service holds its first auction of seized Silk Road bitcoins.

added.label: Ebola international emergency
added.context: WHO declares the West African Ebola outbreak a public-health emergency of international concern.

added.label: Swiss franc currency shock
added.context: The Swiss National Bank removes its minimum exchange rate against the euro.

added.label: China's Black Monday
added.context: Chinese equities fall sharply during a global market selloff.

added.label: Paris attacks
added.context: Coordinated terrorist attacks take place in Paris.

added.label: AlphaGo wins first Lee Sedol game
added.context: AlphaGo plays and wins its first match game against Lee Sedol.

added.label: The DAO attack
added.context: An exploit drains funds from The DAO on Ethereum; this snapshot measures Bitcoin on that date.

added.label: Brexit result
added.context: The UK referendum result confirms a vote to leave the European Union.

added.label: US election: Trump wins
added.context: US presidential election day. Donald Trump wins; the result becomes clear on November 9 UTC.

added.label: WannaCry ransomware outbreak
added.context: The WannaCry ransomware outbreak spreads internationally.

added.label: SegWit locks in
added.context: Block 479,808 begins SegWit’s locked-in period, before activation on August 24.

added.label: Fed raises rates amid selloff
added.context: The Federal Reserve raises its target range to 2.25–2.50 percent.

added.label: Google's quantum supremacy paper
added.context: Google publishes a quantum-sampling benchmark result. It is not a demonstration of breaking Bitcoin’s cryptography.

added.label: WHO declares coronavirus emergency
added.context: WHO declares the novel-coronavirus outbreak a public-health emergency of international concern.

added.label: WHO characterizes COVID-19 pandemic
added.context: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic.

added.label: Fed emergency rate cut and QE
added.context: The Federal Reserve cuts its target rate to near zero and announces further asset purchases.

added.label: WTI oil futures turn negative
added.context: The expiring front-month WTI oil futures contract trades below zero.

added.label: US election: Biden wins
added.context: US presidential election day. Joe Biden ultimately wins; the race is called several days later.

added.label: US Capitol attack
added.context: The US Capitol is attacked during certification of the presidential election.

added.label: Evergrande debt crisis selloff
added.context: Global equities sell off amid concern about Evergrande’s debt problems.

added.label: China's cryptocurrency prohibition
added.context: China publishes its interagency notice restricting cryptocurrency-related business activities.

added.label: Fed raises rates by 75 basis points
added.context: The Federal Reserve raises its target range by 75 basis points.

added.label: ChatGPT launches
added.context: OpenAI releases ChatGPT as a public research preview.

added.label: Turkey and Syria earthquakes
added.context: Major earthquakes strike southern Turkey and northern Syria.

added.label: GPT-4 launches
added.context: OpenAI announces GPT-4.

added.label: Nvidia's AI boom rally
added.context: The trading day after Nvidia’s results and outlook emphasize rapidly growing generative-AI demand.

added.label: Hamas attack on Israel
added.context: Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attack southern Israel, killing civilians and taking hostages.

added.label: Iran attacks Israel directly
added.context: Iran launches a large direct attack on Israel.

added.label: Gold crosses $2,500
added.context: Gold trades above US$2,500 per troy ounce.

added.label: US election: Trump returns
added.context: US presidential election day. Donald Trump wins; results extend into November 6 UTC.

added.label: Google unveils Willow quantum chip
added.context: Google announces Willow and quantum error-correction progress. This is not a demonstration of cracking Bitcoin keys.

added.label: DeepSeek market shock
added.context: Technology stocks sell off amid attention to DeepSeek’s AI models.

added.label: US reciprocal tariff announcement
added.context: The US announces its reciprocal-tariff policy; many measures take effect later.

added.label: Israel strikes Iran
added.context: Israel launches strikes against targets in Iran.

added.label: US strikes Iranian nuclear sites
added.context: US strikes hit Iranian nuclear sites. The US announcement is dated June 21 locally; the strikes fall on June 22 UTC.
